faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Institute of Technology Silchar (NIT Silchar) for research positions in Assam during the academic year 2026-2027.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this notification?
faq.answer: The post name advertised in this notification is Postdoctoral Fellowship (PDF) under the Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of the online application form is 20-10-2026. Candidates must submit their applications before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the PDF position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Postdoctoral Fellowship will receive a monthly salary of ₹1,08,393/month along with an annual contingency grant of ₹1,00,000.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PhD degree from a recognised university with a first class in all preceding levels and a consistent good academic record.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Postdoctoral Fellowship (PDF) position is 40 years as per the notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for NIT Silchar PDF Recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by filling out the Google Form via the provided link and uploading a compiled PDF of their documents.

faq.question: Q8. What documents need to be uploaded?
faq.answer: Applicants must upload a PDF file containing their updated biodata, application form, relevant certificates, and mark sheets compiled together.

faq.question: Q9. When is the tentative interview schedule?
faq.answer: The tentative schedule for the interview of shortlisted candidates has been announced for 28-10-2026 by the organizing committee.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this post?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification for submitting the online application form for these positions.
